established_agrees.detail: Both endpoint validators succeed for an actual deterministic Noise session; handshake hash/community/peer identities and crossed send/receive keys agree natively. The production theorem remains conditional on the size-aware sodium.suite.Good contract. No universal native crypto assumption is discharged.

open_seal.detail: Actual Noise session with 32-byte session ID/key and 24-byte nonce, carrying signed message bytes. The theorem now needs only concrete crypto premises for this frame. Native branches check ciphertext length and AEAD roundtrip, then apply the theorem with every premise discharged. Malformed 0/31/33-byte keys cannot produce certificates; malformed 0/23/25-byte nonces and wrong receive keys are rejected.

cid_seal.detail: Actual Noise session with 32-byte session ID/key and 24-byte nonce, carrying signed message bytes. The theorem now needs only concrete crypto premises for this frame. openFrame_auth.detail: Actual real-crypto Noise session and XChaCha frame carrying signed Bob message bytes. Successful open is certified against held session receive key. One-byte ciphertext corruption proves the universal rejection premise by exact header/key lookup equalities and failed decryption, then applies sealed_auth. Wrong directional key and modified session header also reject; damaged frame emits no sends/drops/stores and preserves held database/log.
